ambiguities.detail: scripts/rollup/forks.js REPLACES specifiers per bundle type at build time (e.g. './packages/shared/ReactSharedInternals.js' is forked because importing it inside the react package would cycle). The same specifier -> different files for www vs OSS vs fb-internal builds. No static default is 'correct'; deterministic file resolution FAILS honestly here. The analyzer currently resolves the naive path at R — a known overclaim this fixture exposes.

Entries are Rollup bundle entries in scripts/rollup/bundles.js (ReactClient.js vs ReactServer.js vs ReactServer.fb.js vs ReactServer.experimental.js). Which is 'the' entry depends on release channel. Unknown statically.
packages/shared/ReactFeatureFlags.js + __EXPERIMENTAL__ from RELEASE_CHANNEL env: both branches visible statically; which executes is build-time truth.
Package 'exports' maps point at built files (index.js, cjs/, esm/) absent from the repo; subpath mapping needs bundles.js, not package.json.
react-server-dom-{esm,parcel,turbopack,webpack}: same logical package published 4x with bundler-specific builds + custom conditions (workerd, deno, edge-light, react-server).
No tsconfig.json at repo root (only in fixtures/ and eslint-plugin-react-hooks). Flow annotations stripped by Babel; a TS-centric resolver handles .js sources or fails loudly — never silently.
